name: glm-market
description: Marketing and market research plugin bundling three strategy skills: glm-content-strategy (an eight-step solopreneur content marketing system covering goals, audience research, pillars, calendar, distribution, repurposing and metrics), glm-marketing-mode (a marketing knowledge base covering 23 domains) and glm-market-research-reports (consulting-grade market research reports of 50+ pages). Trigger for content marketing planning, marketing method lookup and market report generation. Zero SDK, zero network; deliverables land in the user's output directory.

interface.shortDescription: Three marketing skills: the eight-step content strategy system, a 23-domain knowledge base and 50+ page market research reports.
interface.longDescription: GLM Marketing bundles three strategy skills. glm-content-strategy runs the eight-step solopreneur content marketing system — goals, audience research, content pillars, calendar, distribution, repurposing and metrics — producing a complete strategy pack. glm-marketing-mode is a marketing knowledge base covering 23 domains (strategy, psychology, copywriting frameworks, SEO, conversion optimization, paid growth) with audit checklists and discovery questionnaires. glm-market-research-reports generates consulting-grade market research reports of 50+ pages from structured outlines. Zero SDK, zero network; deliverables land in the user's output directory.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the glm-market plugin skills: <内容营销策略 / 营销模式知识库 / 市场研究报告>
